title: Russia Warns of 'Preventive Nuclear Attack'. In 1961 Tanks Stood Gun to Gun #shorts
description:
This week Russia warned of a 'preventive nuclear attack', claiming Ukraine and NATO have crossed a line. In October 1961, American and Soviet tanks faced each other at Checkpoint Charlie in Berlin, in the most dangerous standoff of the early Cold War, and both sides pulled back.
